title: How to enable/disable WhatsApp message at various order stages in QDC
description:
In this video we will understand how to activate various messages for WhatsApp sharing. Lets say you want to share a WhatsApp message while creating an order for the customer. You can do that very easily. let us understand how to do that-

How to activate WhatsApp messages on/off various stages like order creation, ready, delivery and so on.
